an.desc: Deiza's new generation: smarter, faster, with methodical web search. For the first time, a Deiza model helped program its own platform and interface.
an.bullet.1: Methodical web search: verifies, cross-checks and answers with dates.
an.bullet.2: Thinks longer when the task is complex; answers instantly when it is not.
an.bullet.3: Chain fallback: if a model fails, it tries Liquid 4.5 without you noticing.
an.bullet.4: Dhisper, Deiza's new voice engine: dictation that detects the language by itself and natural read-aloud.
an.bullet.5: New interface: composer, Skills and a redesigned conversation list.
an.footnote: Liquid 4.5 stays under "More models". Gas 4.5 and Solid 4.6 are unchanged.

dk.modes.title: Switch between talking and building in one click.
dk.chat.title: Chat
dk.chat.desc: The workspace you know, with everything: artifacts, decks, designed PDF and Word files, search, images, video and voice dictation. It updates itself.
dk.chat.b1: Downloads go straight to your folder, with a system notification.
dk.chat.b2: Global shortcut ⌥⌘Space (Ctrl+Alt+Space on Windows) to open Deiza from anywhere.
dk.chat.b3: The same account and conversations as on the web and on your phone.
dk.code.title: Code
dk.code.desc: Deiza Code with its own interface. Pick a folder and the agent reads the project, writes files, runs commands and checks its work with the Deiza Omniscient engine.
dk.code.b1: Every change with its diff and every command with its live output.
dk.code.b2: Build (autonomous), Copilot (approve each change) and Plan (read-only) modes.
dk.code.b3: Live preview of the pages it builds and a button to revert the last answer.
dk.code.note: Code is included in the Friend and Signet plans. Chat works with any account.
dk.install.title: Install
dk.install.sub: Download the installer or use the one-line command.
dk.install.mac.arm: Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
dk.install.cmd: Or in Terminal, which installs it in Applications and opens it:
dk.install.cmd.win: Or in PowerShell, which installs and opens it:
dk.install.mac.note: The app is not signed with an Apple developer certificate yet. If you download it from the browser, open it the first time from System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway. The command does not need this step.
dk.install.win.note: If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info > Run anyway. The command does not need this step.
dk.faq.title: Questions
dk.faq.q1: Do I need a paid plan?
dk.faq.a1: Not for chat: it works with any account, just like the web. Code mode uses Deiza Omniscient and is included in Friend and Signet.
dk.faq.q2: What can the agent touch on my computer?
dk.faq.a2: It works in the folder you choose. Outside it, it always asks first; it never runs commands that would destroy the system, and in Copilot mode it asks before every change. You can revert the files it changed in the last answer.
dk.faq.a3: Chat updates itself. When there is a new version of the app you will see a notice in the top bar with the download link.
dk.faq.a4: For now, use deiza.org in your browser and Deiza Code from the terminal.
dkan.title: Deiza for desktop
dkan.desc: The workspace and Deiza Code together in one app for macOS and Windows. Switch between Chat and Code in one click and let the agent work in your folders, no terminal needed.
dkan.bullet.1: Chat: the whole workspace, with direct downloads and system notifications.
dkan.bullet.2: Code: the agent edits, runs and shows you every diff live.
dkan.bullet.3: Live preview of the pages it builds and a revert button.
dkan.bullet.4: Sign in once inside the app and it works for both modes.
dkan.footnote: Code is included in Friend and Signet. Chat works with any account.
dk.install.fast: The way without security prompts: paste this in Terminal and Deiza installs in Applications and opens.
dk.install.fast.win: The way without security prompts: paste this in PowerShell and Deiza installs and opens.
dk.steps.title: If you use the installer, the first time
dk.steps.mac.1: Open the .dmg and drag Deiza to Applications.
dk.steps.mac.2: Open it. If macOS says "Deiza Not Opened", click Done.
dk.steps.mac.3: Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll to the Deiza message and click "Open Anyway". It will ask for your password.
dk.steps.win.2: If you see "Windows protected your PC", click "More info".
dk.steps.win.3: Click "Run anyway" and follow the setup.
dk.steps.why: The prompt appears because Deiza is not yet signed with paid Apple and Microsoft certificates. It only happens once: after that the app updates itself from inside, with no prompts.
